0.msg: IT IS I, THE GREAT #eLIL ZAKUM#n. I have graced you puny humans with my grand, if diminutive, presence. I do it in the name of my daddy, the real Zakum.

2.msg: Put your weapon away, barbarian. I, the great Lil Zakum, do not condone violence. I prefer more elegant, sophisticated forms of battle.

4.msg: Observe my eight magnificent hands, how they can form many shapes... I have come to engage you in the classic battle of #e#bRock-Paper-Scissors#n#k. I have spent years, nay, centuries honing my skills. Win against me, you poor two-armed creature, and I will give you my most precious treasure. Do you dare?

yes.0:
I am a busy man, um, boy, um rock-creature. To be worthy of my time, you must bring me a #eRock-Paper-Scissors Ticket#n, which I have given to my minions all around the world. Return to challenge me after you have a ticket, hahaha-zakum!\r\n\r\n

Ahem, a minion in this case just so happens to be any monster near your level range, between #r10 levels below and 20 levels above you#k.
